description: Free (no wallet, nothing paid): look up whether Verdix's address-poisoning watcher has flagged an EVM address as a lookalike or poisoning bait, on Base (default, live) or Ethereum mainnet (chain "ethereum": a DAILY scan, not live). Returns Verdix's JSON unchanged: flagged (true/false), first_seen, kind; on Ethereum also data_through (the last complete UTC day; lookalikes planted after it are not seen yet) and coverage "daily, not live". flagged=true means do not send funds there. flagged=false is NOT a safety verdict: this checks address poisoning only (no sanctions, scam lists or other checks) - use check_address_risk_lite or check_address_risk_quick for a pre-send screen. Rate-limited per IP (30 per minute, 500 per day). A mixed-case address must have a valid checksum.

address.description: The EVM address to look up (the recipient you are about to send to)

chain.description: base (default, live data) or ethereum (daily scan, not live; answer has data_through)

name: check_address_poisoning
title: Free address-poisoning lookup (Base or Ethereum)
